ns2:section.sectionText: Graduate and M.Eng students in Bioengineering wanting to enroll, please contact sh4nier3@illinois.edu for an override. The majority of seats will be held for bioengineering majors until August 15; seats will be released after this date to students who meet prerequisites. If you are not a bioengineering major and have completed MCB 252 instead of BIOE 206, you should submit a prerequisite override request via https://my.bioe.illinois.ed/ugpetitions. Bioengineering students must take BIOE 206.
